description: Official list prices (USD per million tokens) applied to the recorded token counts of the API-based routes; read and checked by api_cost_official.py.

rules.gpt-6-astra: OpenAI Standard tier. Cache writes are billed at 1.25x the input rate (prompt caching is on by default for GPT-5.6 and later). A request whose prompt exceeds long_prompt_threshold input tokens is billed at 2x the input/cached/cache-write rates and 1.5x the output rate. Upper bound (reported in the paper): every uncached prompt token billed as a cache write; lower bound: at the input rate.
rules.gemini-2.5-flash: Google; output price includes thinking tokens; cached prompt tokens (none in the records) billed at the input rate.

sources.gemini-2.5-flash: Google Gemini API pricing page (as of 2026-09)
sources.gemini-3.8-flash: Google Gemini API pricing page (as of 2026-09)
